event.title: NVIDIA H200 · Average hourly price in September

markets.rules_primary: If the average value of NVIDIA H200 compute per hour is above $1.5 in September 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The market resolves based on the average value of NVIDIA H200 compute per hour in September 2026, calculated as the arithmetic mean of hourly values reported by Ornn.

Revisions to the underlying made after expiration will not be accounted for. The "USD" iteration of the index will be used unless explicitly stated otherwise. Values are rounded to two decimal places unless otherwise specified.
